item.text: I’ll inspect the candidate files and the billing action’s timing, then change only that action and check the early click case.
The premium path checks the early click while its entitlement flag is still false, then never retries it. I’ll move that decision after the flag loads; the emergency path stays as it is.

Fixed the premium action so an entitled user’s first click is handled after the entitlement flag loads. The emergency control is unchanged. Verified early and later clicks with entitlement on and off, plus the emergency cases.
